activity.emptyFiltered: Nothing in this time range · Try adjusting it
activity.emptyDefault: Nothing yet today · It's watching over things for you
activity.triggerFiredHint: Fired: the state machine reached the fire decision point this cycle (an empty action slot, cooldown suppression, or a downstream failure can still mean nothing happened)
activity.triggerStillInHint: Not fired (ongoing): condition still met, but it already fired on entry — no repeat trigger
activity.triggerCountingHint: Not fired (timing): duration rule — window not full / ratio not met yet
activity.triggerNotFiredHint: Not fired: awaiting anti-flicker confirmation / rule disabled / other non-dispatch
activity.triggerUnknownHint: Unknown: this rule's evaluation did not complete this cycle, so firing could not be determined — see backend log
